name: 闪动校园
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=闪动校园
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = api.huachenjie.com, open.e.kuaishou.cn, ad.shunchangzhixing.com, zlsdk.1rtb.net

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.huachenjie\.com\/run-front\/ai\/getAICategory/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.huachenjie\.com\/run-front\/home\/sports\/getPopup/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.huachenjie\.com\/run-front\/ad/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^http:\/\/ad\.shunchangzhixing\.com\/getAd/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/open\.e\.kuaishou\.cn\/rest\/e\/v3\/open/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/zlsdk\.1rtb\.net\/sdk\/req_ad\?sdk_version=\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+&device_os=iOS&accept_ad_type=\d+&app_id=\d+&pid=\d+&sdk_version_code=\d+/i then reject_dict(200)
